About Wells

Three generations of dependable pest control

Wells Pest Control is a family owned and operated business servicing Central Ohio and surrounding counties since 1946. We have protected the health and property of our customers for over 80 years.

We specialize in residential, commercial, and industrial pest control services, with factory-trained technicians, all work guaranteed — and membership in the Ohio and National Pest Management Associations.

One-time, monthly, and quarterly service options, with convenient appointments that fit your schedule.

How it works

Simple, honest service — start to finish

No surprises, no pressure. Here is exactly what happens when you call Wells.

Inspect
